mapper.select: /* UploadJobMapper.selectUploadJob */ SELECT JOB_ID AS jobId , CMPNY_CD AS cmpnyCd , USER_CD AS userCd , FILE_NAME AS fileName , FILE_SIZE AS fileSize , TOTAL_ROWS AS totalRows , PROCESSED_ROWS AS processedRows , SUCCESS_COUNT AS successCount , FAIL_COUNT AS failCount , FAILS_JSON AS failsJson , STATUS AS status , ERROR_MSG AS errorMsg FROM TB_USER_UPLOAD_JOB WHERE CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND JOB_ID = #{jobId} LIMIT 1
